factual_claims.claim: Nearly two-thirds of citations generated by GPT-4o in the study were either fabricated or contained bibliographic errors.
The fabrication rate for citations in the study was 6 percent for major depressive disorder, 28 percent for binge eating disorder, and 29 percent for body dysmorphic disorder.
The study analyzed 176 citations generated by GPT-4o across six different literature reviews.
